evidence.summary: Rendered /brief and /lineup/cases at 1707x876 (window) and in same-origin iframes at exactly 1280x800 and 390x844. Cards show as a 4+3 grid at 1280 and one column of 351px at 390, with no horizontal overflow. The Lineup strip shows 5 live figures (7,309 / 96 / 100% / 1646 / 20%). Findings: Planned column header and cells are misaligned; Approval and actions sit off-screen at 1280 behind the grid's horizontal scroll.
